findings.truth: Option A: remove the prevalence claim and define negotiated reading only. Option B: retain it only with evidence from a defined audience study; Hall's three positions do not themselves establish a universal ranking.

summary: The confirmed Lesson 5 errors conflate the model's 1973 development with its 1980 publication. One broad claim about the typical reading position needs an editorial decision.
